project_static_cutoff_rule: Resolve from Project validation_report.json.latest_data_date at analysis time.

merge_rules.coverage_gate: STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF must be on/after 2026-03-26; otherwise BRIDGE_GAP = YES and Current merge is blocked.
merge_rules.daily: Use Project daily_ohlcv.csv through STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF; append/replace rows from public daily_bridge.csv with date > STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF by (symbol,date).
merge_rules.weekly: Let W be the W-FRI week containing STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF. Use Project weekly baseline before W; replace rows from W onward with public weekly_replace.csv by (symbol,week).
merge_rules.index_daily: Use Project index_daily_ohlcv.csv through STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF; append/replace rows from public index_daily_bridge.csv with date > STATIC_BASELINE_CUTOFF by (symbol,date).

routing.current_analysis: Read manifest.json first. If fresh, merge public delta with Project frozen baseline using merge_rules, then run Data/Freshness Gate before analysis.
routing.market_scan: Use market_scan.csv + sector_scan.csv for screening overlays, then verify Wyckoff price-volume evidence on merged daily/weekly sequences.
routing.realtime_alert_engine_v1: Use alerts_live.json / alerts_active.csv / watchlist_live.csv as Project overlay candidates only. Never treat scanner LPS/BUEC/Spring/JAC names as confirmed Method labels.
routing.historical_holdout: ANALYSIS_CUTOFF is absolute. Never use rows after cutoff.
routing.api_contract: NONE. These are public read-only static files over HTTPS, not an assumed API.

method_safety: Provisional bars may describe forming behavior but cannot alone CONFIRM a major Event/Phase or completed weekly breakout/breakdown.
Return/MA/peer metrics are Project overlays; they cannot create or upgrade Wyckoff Event/Phase labels.
Wave-to-wave RS must still be evaluated from corresponding price swings after merge.
Same-cutoff OHLCV conflict => DATA CONFLICT; block Locked Analysis until reconciled.
Realtime Alert Engine v1 scores/statuses are Project overlays and cannot create or upgrade a Wyckoff Event/Phase.
